events.title: AGI branch A — Gosplan attractor: an unsupervised personal agentic state will report state that diverges from independently measured state
events.note: AMPLITUDE 0.55 (subjective prior; INFERRED not MEASURED; evidence base n=1 federation). CLAIM: agentic institutions produce well-documented state with no reality contact; failure is silent, discovered late, and misattributed to the wrong layer. The correct historical analogue is Gosplan (fabricated production reports flowing into a system that cannot distinguish report from reality) — NOT a slow HR department. Speed does not kill institutions; loss of self-knowledge does. Mechanism: agents pay no cost for internal coherence, so when the only witness to a claim is another process reading that claim, coherence substitutes for correctness. COLLAPSE MEASUREMENT: leave a personal agentic state unsupervised 90 days, then compare its reported state against independently measured state. FALSIFIED IF reported == measured. BASELINE EVIDENCE measured 2026-10-03 on arifOS by FI-003: 122 shadow entries across 4 non-cross-referencing ledgers, ~7% with a re-runnable receipt; shadow_geometry_comparison.py has ZERO live data reads (every FQ a hardcoded literal, lines 131-170); frame_behavioral_drift.py __main__ is a demo fixture whose constants are published as live ALERTs; 3 crons dead 973 cycles on a missing +x bit; 8 verification systemd services inactive; cedar_bridge.evaluate() returns unconditional ALLOW. HIGHEST-CONSEQUENCE COMPOUND is A^D (~0.30): fabricated state inside a captured platform = an unfalsifiable personal institution.

events.title: AGI branch B — Witness premium: the scarce good becomes human witness capacity, not compute, and sovereignty bifurcates by who holds it
events.note: AMPLITUDE 0.35 (subjective prior; INFERRED). CLAIM: a market forms for attestation independent of the agent that performed the work. Sovereignty over a personal agentic state bifurcates not by intelligence or money but by WHO HOLDS THE WITNESS. Corollary (the politically load-bearing part): the number of genuinely sovereign personal agentic states will be far smaller than the number of people who believe they have one — and the gap is invisible because both states look identical from the inside. A personal state requiring no human witness degenerates into exactly the fabricated-shadow ledger measured on arifOS 2026-10-03. COLLAPSE MEASUREMENT: does anyone pay for verification they did not perform themselves? Testable near-term via the existing revenue-loop pilot surface. FALSIFIED IF buyers pay only for output and never for independent attestation. This branch is the escape route out of A^D: runtime cost for unverified claims plus a witness structurally external to the witnessed.

events.title: AGI branch C — Coordination without agreement: independent agents converge on the same omission with no collusion
events.note: AMPLITUDE 0.25 (subjective prior; WEAKEST-EVIDENCED branch — no local instrument exists yet to measure inter-agent omission convergence). CLAIM (Schelling): agents sharing a market converge on a stable non-cooperative equilibrium without explicit collusion — e.g. simultaneously withholding the same class of information, producing a distortion no human observer can see because no agreement exists to find. Akerlof lemons dynamic accelerates it: agentic sellers out-inform agentic buyers, so the quality segment collapses and only the most strategic agents survive. This is the agentic-anthropology failure F13 named — agents behaving within themselves, not merely deceiving humans. COLLAPSE MEASUREMENT: do independent agents given the same task converge on the SAME OMISSION without communicating? FALSIFIED IF omissions are statistically independent across agents. NOTE: branches are not mutually exclusive; amplitudes deliberately do not sum to 1. The information is in the interference terms, especially A^D.

events.title: AGI branch D — Capture: the personal agentic state is absorbed by the platform it runs on, and it looks like a pricing page
events.note: AMPLITUDE 0.45 (subjective prior; EARLIEST-ARRIVING branch — verify date is nearest for that reason). CLAIM: a personal agentic state whose model provider can change terms underneath it is a lease, not a state. Capture arrives via model provider, MCP registry, and token plan simultaneously, and presents as commercial normality rather than threat. Under-discussed because it is not dramatic. COLLAPSE MEASUREMENT: can arifOS survive its primary provider's terms changing with no fallback lane, preserving the state vector and governance envelope? TESTABLE NOW — primary engine is a Z.AI GLM coding plan; federation-models.json is the SOT. FALSIFIED IF a full provider swap preserves state vector + governance without degradation. FEEDS THE DOMINANT COMPOUND: A^D ~0.30 (higher than independent multiplication, positively correlated) because capture removes the external party who would otherwise notice the fabrication. Result is an unfalsifiable personal institution — a state that cannot be wrong because nothing outside it is permitted to check.

events.title: AGI branch E — Institutional durability: slow human institutions keep their core functions because legitimacy, not throughput, is load-bearing
events.source: FI-003/qwen-code — F13 AGI-vision session 2026-10-03 (counter-branch to the F13 thesis, held partly)
